title: AnthropicProviderSettings
description: The settings of a model profile whose provider is anthropic: Claude through the Messages API (ADR-0027, ADR-0028).

workspace_id_env.description: When this variable is set, its value is sent as the anthropic-workspace-id header.

ProviderBaseUrl.description: An https URL, or plain http on a loopback host for a local test server. The gateway accepts the loopback form only in the Test environment.

ModelEffort.description: How much the model thinks before answering.

RefusalFallback.description: Anthropic's server-side refusal fallback: a declined request is run again on the model the API picks for the refusal category. Not available for every model.
